summary: Fix correctly resolves the stale-LEVEL_TAGS bug by resolving tags lazily per access instead of at import time, so @override_settings is honored. Main concern is removal of the module-level LEVEL_TAGS symbol (backward-compat) plus a stray blank line.

issues.description: Removes the module-level LEVEL_TAGS name. Third-party/internal code doing `from django.contrib.messages.storage.base import LEVEL_TAGS` breaks. The upstream-preferred approach keeps LEVEL_TAGS and refreshes it via the setting_changed signal, preserving the public symbol.
Adds a stray blank line as the new first line of the file — accidental, unrelated to the fix.
get_level_tags() recomputes tags on every level_tag access with no caching; the old module-level constant was computed once. Negligible in practice but avoidable.
